##### Project general facts

Volta is a premium residential development by DAMAC Properties, strategically located in the heart of Downtown Dubai. The project offers a collection of luxury 1 and 2-bedroom apartments alongside super luxury 3 and 4-bedroom residences, catering to a variety of lifestyle needs. Designed to combine contemporary architecture with urban sophistication, Volta provides residents with direct access to one of Dubai’s most dynamic districts while delivering a refined and modern living environment. The development also features a dedicated 13-storey podium parking structure, enhancing convenience and functionality within the community.

The project is designed to support an elevated lifestyle through a range of carefully planned amenities. A standout feature is the separate podium parking building topped with a rooftop amenity area, providing residents with additional recreational and leisure spaces. Located in Downtown Dubai, Volta benefits from proximity to world-class dining, entertainment, shopping, and cultural attractions, allowing residents to enjoy a vibrant urban lifestyle while maintaining the comfort and exclusivity of a luxury residential tower.

The interiors showcase high-quality contemporary finishes and carefully selected materials throughout. Living and dining areas feature elegant marble flooring, painted walls, and accent feature walls where applicable. Bedrooms are finished with porcelain tile flooring, built-in wardrobes, painted walls, and a highlight wall in the master bedroom. Bathrooms include stone countertops, quality sanitary ware, mirrors, shower enclosures, and standard fittings. Kitchens are fitted with cabinetry, stone countertops, porcelain tile flooring, stainless steel sinks, and a full set of appliances, including a cooker, hood, refrigerator, and washing machine. The apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their living spaces while benefiting from a fully completed premium interior specification.

##### Location description and benefits

Downtown Dubai is the centre of Dubai, constantly evolving at a fast pace. Home to many landmarks and world-famous attractions, including Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Mall and Dancing Fountains, the area is a hub of activities. 

The prime location keeps Downtown busy throughout the year. Constantly attracting tourists, there’re always some new things to do in Downtown Dubai. The area is best known for offering a luxurious lifestyle. It used to be a vertical community, but many villas have also been added to the real estate market. As per Bayut’s 2020 Rental Market Report, it is the second most popular area offering luxury apartments for rent after Dubai Marina. Downtown is well connected to other key commercial and residential areas in the city. 

Strategically located along Sheikh Zayed Road, E11, across Al Wasl and bordering Business Bay, it is a pretty active and bustling neighbourhood. Downtown is one of Dubai’s best areas for non-drivers and frequent travellers. Many amenities, including upscale hotels, chic leisure points and massive shopping centres, make Downtown Dubai a sought-after address and “the centre of now.”
